verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS analytics dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Plausible ships an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The AI-related material only covers tracking referral traffic from AI tools like ChatGPT, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
